questions.question_text: Which organization is known for monitoring global health crises?
questions.explanation: The World Health Organization (WHO) is responsible for international public health.

questions.question_text: Who is currently serving as the Chairman of the Punjab Public Service Commission?

questions.question_text: In which city is the main office of the Punjab Public Service Commission located?

questions.question_text: Who is the current Secretary-General of the United Nations?
questions.explanation: Antonio Guterres is the ninth Secretary-General of the United Nations.

questions.explanation: India held the G20 presidency for the year 2023.

questions.question_text: What is the primary focus of the Paris Agreement?
questions.explanation: The Paris Agreement is a legally binding international treaty on climate change.

questions.explanation: The Euro is the official currency for the majority of EU member states.
